methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $1.54B (to $2.83B) × margin 9.3% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $1.02B
K = capital to build it: $1.54B ÷ sales-to-capital 0.79 = $1.94B
σ = 30% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $142.0M
assets in place = NOPAT $0 ÷ WACC = $0; value = ($0 + $142.0M − net debt $11.76M) ÷ 25,980,000 = $5.01
